en: Pure intuition, having passed out of its immediacy into being-in-and-for-itself, or filled space and time, is matter.
The being-outside-each-other of space and the being-within-itself of time, absolutely set into one, give the concept of matter in general.
zh: 从自身直接性过渡到自在自为存在的纯粹直观，或者说充实的空间和时间，就是物质。
空间的相互外在和时间的自身内存在，绝对地合为一，就给出了物质的一般概念。

en: According to the moment of being-within-itself, matter would be an isolated point; according to the moment of being-outside-itself, it would at first be a multitude of mutually exclusive atoms.

But insofar as these relate themselves to one another just as much through excluding one another, the atom has no actuality, and the atomistic as well as the absolute continuity or the infinite divisibility has in it only a possibility.
zh: 按自身内存在这一环节，物质就会是一个孤立的点；按在外存在这一环节，它首先就会是一堆彼此排斥的原子。
但这些原子通过彼此排除也同样相互关联，因此原子没有现实性，而原子式的以及绝对的连续性或无限的可分性，在其中只是一种可能性。

en: Matter has as being-for-itself the moment of individualization, but the same matter maintains itself just as much in being-in-itself and is only an essential continuity, gravity; gravity constitutes the universal predicate of the body, and matter is precisely this body in the form of the subject.
zh: 物质作为自为存在具有个别化这一环节，但同一个物质同样地在自在存在中保持自身，并且只不过是一种本质的连续性，即重力；重力构成物体的普遍谓项，而物质正是在主体的形式上才是这个物体。

en: The body contains the relation of the ideal moments of space and of time, which relation appears as movement and gravity as its ground.
zh: 物体包含空间与时间的观念环节之间的关系，这一关系显现为运动，重力则是它的根据。

en: Free movement belongs to the bodies that have within them a centre of gravity of their own.

Through the relation of such centres there arises the free system of the circling movement of the heavenly bodies, whereas the other bodies, without a centre of centrifugal force of their own, lack it and are subject to the centripetal force, and by this they fall.
zh: 自由运动属于那些在自身中有一个自己的重力中心的物体。
通过这些中点的相互关系，形成了天体环绕运动的自由体系；相反，那些没有自己的离心力中心的其他物体，则服从向心力，由此而下落。

en: In the magnitude of the movement, besides space and time, mass is a moment, just as space and time too pass over into force and are, like mass, moments of force.
zh: 在运动的大小中，除了空间和时间，质量也是一个环节，正如空间和时间也过渡为力，并且像质量一样是力的环节。

en: Gravity, individualized through light and resolved into qualitative differences, is the concrete or physical nature and the object of physics in general.
zh: 由光个别化并分化成质的差异的重力，就是具体的、也就是物理的自然，也是物理学总的对象。

en: Gravity is the opposite of the being-outside-itself which only strives towards being-within-itself.
Matter is this determinate being of the striving, whose opposite expresses itself only in the moments of space and time, in a merely ideal centre.
That becoming of the being-outside-itself into the being-within-itself, the intensive simple unity of gravity, is a determinate being which confronts it, the free existing self of matter, light.
Light is, as the being-within-itself equal to itself, the principle of the individualization and particularization of matter.
Its relation to what is merely negative for it, to the dark, constitutes color.
zh: 重力是那种只趋向于自身内存在的在外存在的反面。
物质就是这种趋向的定在，而它的对立面只在空间和时间的环节中、在一个纯粹观念的中点上才表达出来。
那种在外存在向自身内存在的生成，即重力内含的单纯统一，是一个与它相对而立的定在，是物质自由存在的自身，就是光。
光作为与自身相等的自身内存在，是物质个别化与特殊化的原则。
它同对它来说纯粹否定的东西、同暗的关系，构成颜色。

en: The first moment of the particular determinate being of the physical nature is magnetism, the direction of the individual point of unity into the opposite, which however still remains enclosed in the concept.
zh: 物理自然的特殊定在，其第一个环节是磁，是那个别统一点朝向对立面的方向，但它仍然被包含在概念之中。

en: The second moment is the realization, namely the becoming-free and the self-constitution of the sides of the contrast: 1. as electricity, which is the still uncorporeal, in absolute tension held against one another, fleeting appearance of the same.
The chemical elements.
They are the qualitative differences of corporeality, in
zh: 第二个环节是实现，即对立两方面的解放与自身的构成：1. 作为电，它是同一者尚未具身、在绝对张力中彼此抵持、飘忽不定的现象。
化学元素。
它们是物体性的质的规定，在

en: shape of their own materials, which, however, are still abstract and without actual individuality.

The physical bodies in which the qualitative determinations are in concrete corporeality, which thereby do indeed contain within themselves all the moments of corporeality, but under the determination of one of these moments or qualities, and which take on the shape of indifferent existence with respect to one another: a) as physical elements, b) as absolute or celestial bodies, and c) as earthly bodies which have passed over into further distribution and individualization.
zh: 自身物质的形态之中，而这些形态还仍是抽象的、没有现实的个体性。
这些物理物体中，质的规定处于具体的物体性之中；它们因此固然在自身中包含物体性的所有环节，但都处在某一个环节或质的规定之下，并且彼此采取无差别存在的形态：a) 作为物理元素，b) 作为绝对的或天上的物体，c) 作为已进入进一步分配与个体化的地上的物体。

en: The third moment is the chemical process.

The individualization and the own indifferent being-for-itself of the bodies is at the same time a relation of these to one another, not only a mutual tension, but also an oppositional positioning and an inspiration to activity and operation, through which their indifferent existence sublates itself and is led back into the unity of the totality.

But this process of return coincides in living nature with the process of construction, through which the union at the same time becomes, from another side, a separation and a precipitation of an indifferent existence.
zh: 第三个环节是化学过程。
物体的个别化以及它自身无差别的自为存在，同时也是这些物体彼此之间的一种关系：不仅是相互的张力，而且是反向设定，并且是对活动与作用的激发；通过它们，物体那无差别的存在自行扬弃，并被导回整体统一体之中。
但这一回归的过程，在有生命的自然中与构造的过程重合：通过构造，这一结合从另一面同时又成为某种无差别存在的析出与沉淀。

26.en: Third Section: Physics of the Organic
26.zh: 第三节 有机自然界的物理

en: Geology regards the formations of the earth as the result of the extinguished process of the formation of the earth-individual.

Geognosy regards these formations in their generality as kinds of rock according to their quality and the relations of their bedding, and distinguishes off mineralogy together with oryctognosy, which regards chiefly the individual formations as components of that general whole and the courses of the veins.
zh: 地质学把大地的各种构造看作大地个体之形成这一已经熄灭的过程的结果。
地质学从普遍性上把这些构造按岩类加以考察，看它们的性质与层位关系；并且连同主要把单个构造看作那些普遍整体之组成部分、把矿脉的走向方式加以考察的矿石学一起，划出矿物学。

en: The vegetable nature is the beginning of the process of self-preservation or of the properly organic process, which becomes individual or subjective, but which as yet does not possess the full power of individual unity, since the plant, which is an individual, possesses only such parts as can again be regarded as independent individuals.
On account of this lack of inner unity it does not attain to feeling.

Plant physiology regards its general nature, but botany the system of this nature, which founds its classification chiefly on the differences of the organs of fertilization, which are the highest point of vegetable life, and by which the plants border on a higher stage of the organism.
zh: 植物性自然是个体地或主体地成为的自我保存过程、也就是真正的有机过程的开端，然而它还不具有个体统一体的全部力量，因为植物虽然是一个个体，却只拥有那些本身又可以被看作独立个体的部分。
由于这种内在统一性的欠缺，它达不到感觉。
植物生理学考察它的一般自然，植物学则考察其体系；植物学的分类主要建立在受精器官的差别之上，而受精器官是植物性生命的最高端点，植物由此与有机的更高阶段相接。

en: The animal nature possesses that subjective unity by which all organic parts are subordinated to a whole which is one.

The physiology of the animal organism regards the functions of the parts which cooperate in the continuous production of the whole and are just as much produced and preserved through this process. - Comparative anatomy regards the general type of the animal in the different formations of the general genus, partly how the same begins to show itself in the simplest animal organizations and emerges more and more developed, partly how it modifies itself according to the different elements in which animal genera come forth.

Zoology classifies them first according to their common principal marks and takes its determination for this from the principal stages of the development of the animal type, then from the element, and then from the weapons in relation to others, but nature blurs the determinate boundaries which first present themselves here through the transitions which unite one principle with another.
zh: 动物性自然具有那种主观统一性，一切有机的部分都由它而服从于一个为一的整体。
动物有机体的生理学考察各部分的功能，这些功能共同促成整体的持续产生，并且也由这一过程产生出来、得到保存。——比较解剖学考察动物的普遍类型在作为普遍属的不同构造中的表现：一方面看同一个类型如何在最简单的动物组织中开始显现，并逐步以更发展的形态出现；另一方面看它如何依照动物各属所出现于其中的那些不同元素而发生变形。
动物学首先按照它们共同的主要特征来分类，其分类的依据取自动物类型发展的主要阶段，取自元素，然后取自相对于其他动物的武器；但自然通过那些把一个原则与另一个原则统一起来的过渡，抹去了这里首先呈现的那些确定界限。

en: The organism stands, with respect to the moment of its irritability, in relation to its unorganic nature in general.
This separation is present at first subjectively within the organism itself, as a feeling of lack, as a need.
This subjective separation is mirrored outward into the contrast between organic and unorganic nature.

The unorganic potencies behave toward the organism as excitants, and its activity is the constant struggle to take them into itself according to its receptivity, but to overpower them therein, and thereby to restore the unity within itself, which itself is just such a course of the contrast of the inner systems with one another and a restoration of them.
zh: 有机体就其感应性的这一环节而言，总的说来同自己的无组织自然处在相互关系中。
这种分离首先在它自身内部主观地存在着，表现为一种匮乏感、一种需要。
这种主观的分离向外映现为有机自然与无组织自然之间的对立。
无组织的诸种力对有机体表现为刺激；而有机体的活动就是一场持续不断的斗争：按其接受性把这些力摄入自身，又在其中压倒它们，从而在自身中重新恢复统一；而这一统一本身也只是内部诸系统彼此对立的这样一种进程，以及对它们的恢复。

en: The organism is in the state of illness when a potency posited within it cannot be overcome by it, settles into a system which is thereby individualized, persists in its own activity and no longer passes over into the fluid activity of the whole, and thus in general makes the organic process an interrupted one.
The science of illness and of its cure is medicine.
zh: 有机体处在疾病的状态，当一个在它里面被设定的潜能不能被它克服、在其中安顿下来因而个别化为一个系统、固守着自己的活动而不再过渡到整体的流动的活动里去时，一般说来这就使有机过程成为一个中断的过程。
关于疾病及其治愈的科学就是医学。

en: The animal has feeling, in so far as its organic moments have their determination and significance simply in the unity of life alone, but at the same time they have also an external being-outside-one-another.
The last reflection of this externality into the abstract element of simplicity, which alone constitutes the complete existence of the moments, is the elevation into spirit.
zh: 动物具有感觉，就在于它的有机环节仅仅在生命的统一之中才具有自己的规定和意义，但这些环节同时还另有一个在外部彼此分离的状态。
这种外在性向单纯性的抽象要素所作的最后反思——只有这个要素才构成诸环节的完全存在——就是向精神的提升。

39.zh: 第三部分　精神的科学

en: Spirit begins only from the external, determines this, and thenceforward relates itself only to itself and to its own determinations.
zh: 精神只是从外在的东西开始，对它加以规定，此后便只与自身以及与自己的规定相关联。

en: The philosophy of spirit contains three sections.
It considers 1. spirit in its concept, psychology in general, 2. the realization of spirit, 3. the completion of spirit in art, religion and science.
zh: 精神的哲学包含三个部分。
它考察：1. 精神在概念中的样子，即一般的心理学；2. 精神的实现；3. 精神在艺术、宗教和科学中的完成。

44.en: First Section Spirit in Its Concept
44.zh: 第一部分　精神在其概念中

en: Spirit considered by itself is to be comprehended 1. in its natural determinate being and its immediate connection with the organic body, and its consequent dependence on the body's affections and states; anthropology.
As appearing, that is, in so far as spirit relates itself as subject to something other as object, spirit is consciousness and the object of the Phenomenology of Spirit.
As spirit according to the determinations of its activity within itself, it is the object of psychology. 3)
zh: 就精神自身来看，应当加以概念把握的是：1. 精神在它的自然定在之中、在它与有机身体的直接联系之中，以及在由此而来的对身体的感受与状态的依赖之中；这就是人类学。
作为显现的东西——也就是说，就精神作为主体而把某个他物当作客体与之相关联而言——精神就是意识，是《精神现象学》的对象。
作为按照其自身内部活动的规定而言的精神，它是心理学的对象。3)

en: Intelligence begins with externality as its condition, but not as its principle, which is rather itself.

It is 1. immediately as feeling, whose content it 2. raises to representation within itself, and 3. as thinking purifies the content from contingency to necessity and from particularity to the universality of its determinations.
zh: 理智是从外在性作为自己的条件开始的，但不是作为自己的原则，理智的原则毋宁就是它自己。
它是1. 直接地作为感觉，其内容它2. 在自身中提升为表象，以及3. 作为思维把内容从偶然性净化到必然性、从特殊性净化到其规定的普遍性。

en: Feeling is the simple, though determinate, affection of the individual subject, in which as yet no distinction between itself and its content is posited; or it is a determination posited in the subject, which has not yet separated itself from the object.
zh: 感觉是个别主体的单纯的、但有规定的感受，其中还没有设定它自身与内容之间的区别；或者说，它是在主体中被设定的一种规定，而这个主体还没有从客体中分离出来。

en: Feeling is partly internal, partly external, and is immediately, still without reflection, as a mood something agreeable or disagreeable.
zh: 感觉一部分是内在的，一部分是外在的，并且它直接地、还未经反思，作为一种心情而是一个令人愉快的或令人不愉快的。

en: Feeling is the original, still enveloped in itself, material which intelligence raises to representation by sub-lating the form of simplicity which feeling has, and by separating the same into an objective and into a subjective which separates itself from it, and thus makes feeling into something felt.
zh: 感觉是原初的、还包裹在自身之中的材料，理智把它提升到表象，做法是：扬弃感觉所具有的单纯形式，并把同一个东西分离开来，分成一个客观的东西和一个从中分离出来的主体的东西，从而把感觉变成被感觉的东西。

en: Only in representation does one have an object.

The stages of representing are: that the intellect 1. remembers, in that it separates itself entirely from the content of feeling, 2. imagines this content to itself, retains it without its object, calls it up freely from itself and connects it, 3. takes from it its immediate meaning and gives it another meaning and a connection in memory.
zh: 只有在表象中，人才有一个对象。
表象的各个阶段是：理智 1. 回忆，由于它彻底与感觉的内容分离开来，2. 把这一内容设想给自己，在没有对象的情况下把它保留下来，自由地从自身中把它召唤出来并加以联结，3. 去掉它直接的意义，在记忆中给它另一种意义和一种联结。

en: Intuition is the immediate representation in which the determinations of feeling are made into an object separated from the subject, which is free of the single subject and at the same time is for it.
But just as little is it for it as a single one, but for all.
zh: 直观是直接的表象，其中感觉的各项规定被做成一个与主体分开的对象，这对象摆脱了单个主体，同时又为这个主体而存在。
但同样地，它也不是只为一个个体而存在，而是为所有个体而存在。

en: The object, posited as it is outside the subject and in itself as a being outside one another, is partly the quiet coexistence of space, partly the unquiet becoming in the succession of time.
Space and time are the abstract intuition or the universal forms of intuition.
zh: 对象，就其被设定为在主体之外、并且就其本身而言是一个彼此外在的东西而言，一半是空间中安静的并置，一半是时间相继之中的不安的生成。
空间和时间是抽象的直观，或者说是直观的一般形式。

en: In these universal objective elements the object is, besides having the content of the determinations of feeling, at the same time a single one, completely determined in space and time, connected with other objects before, beside and after [it].
zh: 在这些一般的客观要素中，对象除了具有感觉规定的内容之外，同时还是一个单个的、在空间和时间中被完全规定的、与其他对象在它之前、旁边和之后[与之]相联系着的对象。

en: (Things are caught by this determinacy in time and space and by one another according to their determinations, and are in the general prison.)
zh: （诸物通过时空中这一规定性、并且依照各自的规定而彼此相互制约，便被囚禁在普遍的牢狱之中。）

en: Representation.
Feeling becomes objective in intuition.
The subject is immersed in it in immediate relation to it, so that in intuiting it actually has as yet nothing other than that objective, spatial and temporal being.

The free activity of the intellect consists here in attention to the diverse determinate being of what is present and in the arbitrariness by which one dwells on one content or passes over to another; strength to hold oneself.
zh: 表象。
感觉在直观中成为客观的。
主体与它直接相关，沉浸在其中，以至于在直观时它其实还没有别的，只是那个客观的、空间和时间的存在。
理智在这里的自由活动在于对当下多样之定在的专注，在于任意，即停留在一个内容上还是过渡到另一个内容；定力。

en: Intuition is however at the same time, as object, for the subject.
This latter, as the being in and for itself, withdraws from its being-outside-self, reflects into itself and separates itself from objectivity, by making the intuition subjectively into an image.
zh: 不过直观作为对象同时又是为主体的。
后者作为自在自为的存在，从它的在外存在中返回，反思于自身，并且由于在主观方面把直观做成形象而与客观性分离开来。

en: Intuition, transferred into the I, is not only image but becomes representation in general.
It does not stop at the point that the intuition taken up into the interior corresponds entirely to the immediate intuition, but it is liberated from its connection in space and time and taken out.
It is a sublated determinate being, that is, just as much a being that is not as one that is preserved.
zh: 被移入自我之中的直观不只是形象，而且成为表象本身。
事情并不停留在这被接纳到内部的直观完全对应于直接直观这一点上，而是它从在空间和时间中的联系里被解放出来、被提取出来。
它是一个被扬弃的定在，也就是同样既是不存在的、又是被保存下来的定在。

en: Intuition is as representation the subject's own time and the subject's own space, into which time and space as universal forms are transferred.
Through the sublation of the particular time of the intuition it becomes enduring; through the sublation of its particular space it is everywhere.
zh: 直观作为表象，是主体自己的时间和自己的空间，时间与空间作为一般形式被移入其中。
通过扬弃直观自身特殊的时间，它成为持久的；通过扬弃它自身的特殊空间，它便处处都在。

en: Further, the concrete intuition is preserved in its manifold determinacies, or in its unity, but is just as much also freed from the bond of its individuality.
The partial determinacies fall apart and become abstractions, which are presented for themselves as subsisting apart from the sensuous connection in which they first appeared to the subject.
zh: 此外，具体直观在其多种多样的规定中、或者在其统一中被保存下来，但同样也从其个别性的束缚中解放出来。
各个部分规定彼此散落开来，成为抽象物；这些抽象物各自被表象为独立存在，而没有了它们最初向主体显现时所在的感性联系。

en: Recollection.
Representation, as the recollected or universalized intuition, relates itself to the immediate intuition as the abiding and the universal to the individual.
Recollection is not so much a comparison of two individual intuitions as that the present individual intuition is subsumed under the one already made universal, under the representation.

The sameness which I recognize is on the one hand the identity of their content; on the other hand, in the present intuition I recognize the identity of myself with myself, or I recollect myself in it.
zh: 回忆。
表象，作为被回忆的、被普遍化的直观，与直接直观相对，就像持存者和普遍者相对于个别者。
回忆与其说是对两个个别直观的比较，不如说是：当前的个别直观被归摄到那个已被普遍化的东西、即表象之下。
我所认识到的这种同一，一方面是它们内容上的同一；另一方面，我在当前的直观中认识到我与我自身的同一，也就是我在这直观中回忆我自己。

en: The image or representation does not become something universal through the same intuition being repeated often and these several intuitions falling together into an image that would be more or less abstract, either consciously or in such a way that at each single intuition one recalls the preceding one; rather, the intuition receives immediately the form of universality in that I take it up.
It is therefore a subsumption.
In recollection, through a present intuition or representation, the image of a past one is called up, which was the very same as the present one.
That preceding one is the enduring and the universal, under which I subsume the present individual one.
zh: 意象或表象并不会因为同一直观被多次重复、这些多个直观融入一个或多或少有些抽象的意象（或者是有意识地这样做，或者是在每一次个别直观时都回想起前面那一次），就变成某种普遍者；毋宁说，直观直接获得普遍性的形式，是因为我把它接纳下来。
所以这是一种归摄。
在回忆中，由一个当前的直观或表象唤起一个过去直观的意象，那个过去直观与当前的正是同一个。
前面那一个就是持存者和普遍者，我把当前的个别者归摄在它之下。

en: In recollection the representation of the former intuition and the present one fall immediately into one another.

I do not have two things before me, the intuition and the representation, but only this: that I have already had it, that it is already mine; insofar, then, as I also have the representation before me as different from the intuition, this is the imagination.
In that respect, however, intuition and representation can also be entirely different.
zh: 在回忆中，从前那个直观的表象与当前的直观直接合到一处。
我面前并不是两样东西——直观和表象——而只有一点：那个直观我早已有过，它早已是我的了；就此而言，我面前还另有一个与直观相异的表象，这就是想象力。
在这个意义上，直观与表象也可以全然不同。

en: Reproduction of representation in general.

The imagination as the reproduction of representation in general calls up the images and representations again, without the present intuition corresponding to them, and lets them enter consciousness on their own.
zh: 表象的一般的再现。
想象力作为表象的一般再现，把意象和表象重新唤起，并不依靠与它们相应的当前直观，而让它们各自进入意识。

en: As active, the imagination brings the stored-up images and representations into manifold connections with one another, which are different from those they had as intuitions.
zh: 作为能动的，想象力把保存着的意象和表象彼此置于多种多样的联系之中，这种联系不同于它们作为直观时所具有的那种联系。

en: This connection can occur according to the manifold determinations which the representations contain.
The various modes of connection have been very inappropriately called the laws of association of ideas.
zh: 这种联接可以按照表象所包含的种种规定而发生。
这些不同的联接方式被很不恰当地称为观念联想的规律。

en: The determination of the connection can be a more or less superficial or a more or less thorough connection: mere simultaneity or the same place of two representations, - or some similarity of these, and also their contrast, the relation of whole and part, cause and effect, ground and consequence, etc., in short every kind of sensuous or spiritual relation.
This connection stands above all under the dominion of an interest of the mind, of a passion, or of the spiritual character in general.
zh: 联结的确定可以是较表面或者较深透的一种联系：两个表象单纯的同时发生或同一处所，——或它们之间某种相似，甚至对比，整体与部分的关系，原因与效果，根据与结果等等，总而言之，每一种感性的或精神的关联。
这种联系首先服从于心灵的某种利害、某种激情，或者总的说来服从于精神性格。

en: The distinction of the images from the intuitions has been indicated in what has been said so far.
Ordinary consciousness makes this distinction immediately in the waking and healthy state.

But in sleep, in extraordinary states, in illness this distinction falls away for that same consciousness, and the imagination governs it over against intuition and over against the higher spiritual powers.
zh: 图像与直观之间的区别在前述部分已经交代过了。
通常的意识在清醒而健康的状态中就直接作出这个区别。
但在睡眠中、在异常的状态中、在疾病中，这同一个意识的这一区别就消失了，想象力压倒直观、压倒更高的精神能力而支配着它。

en: a. Dreaming.

In dream-sleep series of representations come before us which we do not distinguish from intuitions, which are occasioned by memories or also by present sensations, but which are otherwise most accidentally and arbitrarily intermingled and strung on one to another. - To presentiments, visions and enthusiasm etc. there do indeed lie beneath them deeper interests or powers than mere imagination, but they are connected with a peculiar enhancement of the same which makes inner, darker feelings into images and gives them the strength of intuitions.
zh: a. 做梦。
在梦睡中，一系列表象出现在我们面前，我们分不出它们与由回忆或者也由当下的感觉所引起的那些直观之间的区别，不过它们彼此却以最偶然、最任意的样子混杂起来、串接起来。——预感、幻象、狂热等等，其下确实潜藏着比单纯的想象力更深的利害或力量，但它们与想象力的某种特殊提升相联系，这种提升把内在的、更幽暗的情感化为图像，并赋予它们直观的力量。

en: (Sympathy with nature.
So-called foreseeing.
In actuality the future sleeps.
Actuality is at the same time the possibility of what follows.
Oracles, prophecy from the flight of birds, from the entrails of animals.
An attunement through nature in general, as the animals sense the earthquakes in advance.

Peoples who live more in unity with nature have a stronger connection with it than we, who have torn ourselves away from nature. - Inner light; intercourse with higher spirits; the witches' salve of hyoscyamus; the witches benumbed themselves and fell into a terrible phantasy which became epidemic.
They were burned by the thousands. - Ghosts; often outward appearances as the occasion which phantasy seizes upon.

The bad conscience, tortured by the anguish of crime, makes itself objective through ghostly shapes. - Prearrangements to appear after death while still in life. - Enthusiasm; fanaticism, esteeming religious representations higher than everything ethical in life and than relations of concept.
Enthusiasm falls into the delusion of superposing an imageless shaping upon the palpable exteriority.
The sensuous is to stand higher than the spiritual.
The Absolute is to lay itself into the exteriority.

In the thing one wants to see God without art; or one wants to bring the absolute essence before phantasy for inner intuition; one wants to shift God into the temporal and the sensuous. - The true superiority of representation over intuition through the will, e.g. Mucius Scaevola.)
zh: （与自然的感应共鸣。
所谓的预知。
在现实性中，未来在沉睡。
现实性同时也就是随后者的可能性。
神谕；由鸟的飞翔、由动物的肠胃所得的预言。
由自然而来的普遍情绪，例如动物预先感觉到地震。
那些更多地生活在与自然的统一之中的民族，同自然的联系比我们——我们已把自己从自然那里撕裂开来——更强。——内在的光明；同更高精灵的交往；莨菪（Hyoscyamus）的女巫药膏；女巫们使自己昏麻，陷入一种可怕的幻想，这种幻想变成了流行病。
她们成千上万地被烧死了。——鬼魂；往往是外在的现象，想象力抓住了它当作缘由。
受罪恶的痛苦折磨的邪恶良心，通过幽灵般的形象而客观化了。——约定自己在死后仍于生前现身。——狂热；宗教狂，认为宗教表象高于生活中一切伦理的东西、高于概念间的关系。
狂热陷入了这样一种谬想：在摸得着的外部性之上再添一层无图像的塑造。
感性应当高于精神。
绝对者应当沉入外部性之中。
人们想在事物中看见上帝，而不要艺术；或者人们想把绝对本质搬到想象面前来做内在的直观；人们想把上帝推进时间性的、感性的东西里。——表象凭意志而对直观具有的真实的支配力，例如穆齐乌斯·斯凯沃拉。）

en: b) A higher degree of the life which encloses itself into phantasy is somnambulism, the proper night-walking, or other states of this kind, in which, with weaker or stronger outer sensation, the spirit has a more internal intuition of the exterior, is active within itself in general, and proceeds to whole series of outward performances such as one undertakes while awake.
zh: b) 把自身收进幻想之中的那种生命的一个更高阶段，是梦游，即真正的夜游，或者这一类的其他状态；在这些状态里，在外界感觉较弱或较强的情况下，精神对外物有一种更内在的直观，总之是在自身内部活动，并继续去做成成串的外在活动，如同人在清醒时所做的那样。

en: (Somnambulism is α) the ordinary kind, in sleep: hearing music, reading, writing letters, speaking, going to dangerous places.

Washbasins before the bed; violent shocks; β) the epileptic kind; reading through the fingers, on the stomach, and so on; γ) the magnetic kind; the patient answers only the person who stands in rapport with him.)
zh: （梦游有 α) 睡眠中常见的那一种：听音乐、读书、写信、说话、到危险的地方去。
在床前放水盆；剧烈的震动；β) 癫痫的那一种：隔着手指、在肚子上读书等等；γ) 磁力的那一种：病人只回答那个同他处于感应共鸣之中的人。）

en: e) Madness has further that, since fantasizing in the fever heat is a similar state dependent on illness, it has very different modifications such as foolishness, raving madness, frenzy and so on, and it is altogether an overpowering of fantasied representations in the waking state over the intuitions and the intelligible representations.
Foolishness has some single, fixed representation that is crazed, and is bound up in that fixed representation with the soundness of the remaining representations.
Raving madness is a general destruction of the spiritual nature.
As frenzy or raving, this madness is connected with an evil and malicious will and with raging outbursts.
zh: e) 疯狂还有一点：因为发热时的幻游也是一种类似的、依赖疾病的状态，疯狂便有极为不同的形态，如痴愚、癫狂、狂乱等等；总的说来，疯狂就是清醒状态下的幻想表象对直观和通晓事理的表象的一种压倒。
痴愚有一个单独的、固定的表象，这表象是错乱的；而在这一固定表象里，它同其余表象的正确性联结在一起。
癫狂是精神本性的普遍破坏。
作为狂乱或暴疯，这种错乱同邪恶而阴险的意志以及暴烈的发作联结在一起。

en: (Fancying oneself to be a king, a cardinal, a person in the Deity.
Melancholy from the representation of moral worthlessness.

Someone believed that when he urinated he would flood a whole city; another that he was a grain of barley and the hens would eat him; a third that he had feet of glass and a small bell inside his body, and so on. - The causes are α) bodily; often a natural, inherited disposition; impressions from the time of pregnancy; excesses; poisonous herbs; rabies; disease-matter which throws itself upon the nerves, upon the brain, and so on; β) mental; a most lively representation, for example people have not only died of joy but have even become mad; disruption through passions, love, pride, hope, vanity, deception; mistrust tears apart the connection with the external world; burying one's life within oneself, in one's individuality, and so on. - The mode of healing the disorders of the soul is therefore likewise bodily and mental.)
zh: （幻想自己是国王、红衣主教、是神性中的一位位格。
由于道德上毫无价值这一表象而生起的忧郁。

有人以为自己一撒尿就会淹掉整座城；另一个人以为自己是一粒大麦，鸡会把他吃掉；第三个人以为自己长着玻璃做的脚，身体里有个小铃铛等等。——病因因此是：α) 身体的：往往是天然的、遗传的素质；怀孕期间受到的印象；放纵；毒草；狂犬病；投到神经上、投到脑上的致病物质等等；β) 精神的：一种极其生动的表象，例如有些人不仅因喜悦而死，甚至因喜悦而疯癫；受激情、爱情、骄傲、希望、虚荣、欺骗的摧折；不信任把与外部世界的联系撕裂开来；把自己的生活封在自身里面、埋进自己的个别性里等等。——因此，对灵魂错乱的治疗方式同样是身体的，也是精神的。）

en: Productive power of imagination.

The higher power of imagination, the poetic fantasy, does not stand in the service of accidental states and determinations of the mind, but in the service of the ideas and of the truth of spirit in general.

It strips off the contingent and arbitrary circumstances of determinate being, lifts out what is inward and essential in it, and shapes and gives form to it. - This form of appearing determinate being which it gives it is borne, governed, pervaded and joined into unity by nothing but the essential. - The symbolizing of the power of imagination consists in this: that it underlays sensible appearances or images with representations or thoughts of a kind other than what they immediately express, which however stand in an analogous relation to them and present those images as the expression of the same.
zh: 能生产的想象力。
较高的想象力，即诗意的幻想，并不服务于心灵那些偶然的状态和规定，而是服务于观念以及精神总体的真理。
它剥去定在那里的偶然与任意的情状，把它内在的、本质的东西提取出来，加以塑造并赋予形态。——它赋予显现着的定在的这一形态，只是由本质的东西承载着、支配着、贯穿并联结为一个统一。——想象力的象征活动在于：它在感性现象或图像之下置入与它们直接所表达者不同的表象或思想，但这些表象同那些图像有一种类似的关系，并把那些图像当作同一者的表达呈现出来。

en: (That poetizing is not an imitation of nature.
Poetry is in a higher sense true than ordinary actuality.
The poet is a deep spirit who sees through the substance which another also has within him, but which does not come to his consciousness.
It holds here too that there are no heroes for the valet.
That means: I did indeed know this one too, but I saw nothing of it; or: I knew love too, but I found in it nothing of what the poet says of it.

Therefore the poet is a seer. - The poet unites the splendor of nature into a whole as an attribute of something higher: ether-blue is his garment, blossoms his messengers, and so on. - Ceres and Proserpina.
The basis of the idea. - Summer: forget-me-not. - Sunrise: "Thus the sun emerged, as repose wells up from virtue."

Sunset: "Thus a hero dies." - The symbolism of bread and wine in the Eleusinian mysteries and in Christianity. - A deep soul symbolizes in general; the inclination of the Germans for the thought-poetry of nature, and so on.)
zh: （作诗并不是模仿自然。
诗在更高的意义上比普通的现实性更为真实。
诗人是一个深刻的精神，他看穿了那种实体；另一个人身上也有这种实体，可它并没有进入那个人的意识。
这里同样成立：对贴身仆人来说没有英雄。
也就是说：我同样认识这个人，可一点也没看出来；或者说：我同样认识爱情，可在它里面没有找到诗人所说的任何东西。
所以诗人是一个先见者。——诗人把自然的华美合为一个整体，把它当作某个更高者的属性：以太蓝是他的衣袍，花朵是他的信使等等。——刻瑞斯与普洛塞耳庇娜。
观念的根据。——夏天：勿忘我。——日出：「太阳就这样涌出来，像安息从德性中涌出来。」
日落：「一位英雄就这样死去。」——面包与酒在厄琉息斯秘仪与在基督教中的象征。——一颗深沉的心灵总归爱作象征；德国人倾向于对自然作思想诗等等。）

en: The sign in general.
In that the representation has been freed from external determinate being and made subjective, that determinate being and the inner representation have stood opposed to each other as different.

The arbitrary linking of an external determinate being with a representation which does not correspond to it but is even different from it in content, so that the former is to be the representation or the meaning of the latter, makes that determinate being into a sign.
zh: 符号总论。
当表象从外在的定在中被解放出来并成为主观的以后，这一定在与内在的表象便作为彼此不同的东西相对而立。
把一个外在的定在同一个并不与它相应、按内容也与它不同的表象任意联结起来，使前者成为后者的表象或含义——这就使那个定在成为了一个符号。

en: The productive memory thus brings forth the connection of intuition and representation, but a free connection, in which the preceding relation, in which the intuition lies at the basis of the representation, is reversed.
In the connection of the productive memory, sensible determinate being has no value in and for itself, but only that which the spirit gives it.
zh: 所以生产性记忆把直观与表象的联结产生出来，但这是一种自由的联结；在这种联结里，先前那个关系——在其中直观是表象的基础——被颠倒过来了。
在生产性记忆的联结里，感性的定在自身既没有价值，只有精神给它的那一份价值。

en: Sensible determinate being refers, through its determinations in general, to other determinate being.

But since through the productive memory a representation has been made to be its determination, it becomes essentially, in this respect, a relation of representations to other representing beings, and the theoretical communication of these with one another begins therein.
zh: 感性的定在通过它的一般规定，总是指向别的定在。
但由于通过生产性记忆，一个表象成了它的规定，它就在这一点上本质地成了表象与其他能表象的存在者之间的关系；而这些表象彼此之间的理论传达，也就由此开始。

en: Language.
The highest work of the productive memory is language, which is partly sound-language and partly written language.
Since the productive memory, or the Mnemosyne, is the origin of it, one can speak of a further origin only with reference to the invention of the determinate signs.
zh: 语言。
生产性记忆的最高作品是语言，语言一部分是声音语言，一部分是书写语言。
既然生产性记忆，也就是 Mnemosyne（记忆），是它的起源，那么只有在考虑到那些确定符号的发明时，才可以谈一个更进一步的起源。

en: The tone is the fleeting appearance of an inwardness which does not remain something external in this expression, but announces itself as something subjective and inward that essentially means something; - it is above all important that through the articulation of the sounds not only images in their determinations, but also abstract representations be designated; - the concrete representation is made into something imageless in general by the verbal sign, something that identifies itself with the sign.
zh: 声音是内在性的短暂现象，这种内在性在这种表达里并不停留在外在的东西上，而是作为一个主观的、内在的东西显露出来，这个东西本质上是有所指的；——特别重要的是，通过声音的发音，不仅是图像及其规定，而且抽象的表象，也会被标示出来；——具体的表象一般通过词语符号被变成一个无图像的东西，这个东西与符号自身同一。

en: (The image is killed, and the word stands in for the image.

This is a lion; the name holds for the thing. - Logos; God spoke, and so forth. - Language is the highest power among human beings. - Adam, it is said, gave all things (animals) their names. - Language is the killing-out of the sensuous world in its immediate determinate being, the being-sublated of the same into a determinate being which is an appeal that echoes in all representing beings.)
zh: （图像被杀死，词语代替图像。
这就是一头狮子；这个名字管用于这个事物。——Logos（言）；上帝如此说，如此等等。——语言是人中间最大的力量。——据说亚当给了一切事物（动物）起名。——语言是感性世界在其直接定在中的杀残，是感性世界被扬弃为一个定在，而这个定在是一种召唤，在一切能表象的存在者中回响。）

en: With regard to the invention of the determinate signs it is natural that immediate imitations of them be made as sound-signs for sounding phenomena (rustling, whirring, ringing, humming, and so forth); - for other sensuous objects or alterations the sign is in general arbitrary.

For the designation of abstract relations and determinations it is above all the symbolizing that enters in, and the further development of language belongs to the power of universality, to the understanding.
zh: 就确定符号的发明说，自然会对发声的现象（沙沙、筩等、叮当、低鸣等等）作出它们的直接摹仿，当作声音符号；——对别的感性对象或变化说，符号总体上是任意的。
为了标示抽象的关系和规定，主要是象征化登场；而语言的进一步发展，则属于普遍性的力量，属于知性。

en: The written language is hieroglyphic or alphabetic.

The hieroglyphic is a designation of the objects which has no relation to their sounding sign; - against a general philosophical written language, of which several have conceived, there stands the inestimably great multitude of signs that would be necessary, especially to be invented and to be learned; - the alphabetic written language resolves the word-signs into their simple sounds and designates these.
zh: 书写语言或是象形的，或是字母的。
象形文字是一种对对象的标示，这种标示与对象的鸣响符号没有关系；——而一种好几位思想家都曾设想过的普遍哲学书写语言，它所面对的是数量大得无法估量的符号，这些符号尤其是必须被发明出来并学会；——字母的书写语言把词语符号分解为它们的基本声音，并标示这些声音。

en: The reproductive memory.

It is the keeping of the individual signs in relation to what they signify, and above all the holding together of imageless series of them, which are not connected with one another through an imagelike or intelligible connection, but are in a wholly arbitrary or accidental sequence, and are held together in this way by mere inner, independent force.
zh: 再现的记忆。
它是单个符号相对于所指之物的保持，尤其是对无图像的符号系列的固定；这些符号不是通过图像式的或者可理解的联系彼此联结，而是处在一种完全任意的或作广的顺序里，并且靠单纯的、内在的独立的力量这样被保持在一起的。

en: Thinking is the activity of the spirit in its independent simplicity which is equal to itself, which posits determinations out of itself and in itself which have the character of self-equality and universality.
zh: 思维是精神在其独立的、与自己相等的单纯性中的活动；这种单纯性从自身出发并在自身中设定规定，这些规定具有自我相等和普遍性的性状。

en: The understanding is the thinking determination as such and the holding fast in determinations that have been thought.
As objective understanding it contains the categories, the thought-determinations of being, which constitute the inner unity of the manifold of intuitions and representations.
It distinguishes the essential from the inessential and recognizes the necessity and laws of things.
zh: 知性就是一般的思维规定，以及保持在被思维的规定之中。
作为客观的知性，它包含诸范畴，即存在的思维规定，它们构成直观和表象之杂多的内在统一。
它区分本质的与非本质的，并认识事物的必然性和规律。

en: Judging is the relating of an individual to the concept.
It determines the individual in a general way as such, or subsumes it under the universal.
It has the following stages:
zh: 判断就是把个别者同概念联系起来。
它总起来是以普遍的方式规定个别者，或者把个别者归摄到普遍者之下。
它有以下这些阶段：

en: a) the universal, as which the individual is determined, is itself only some quality of the individual, of which it has several.
zh: a) 普遍者——个别者由之得到规定——本身也只是个别者的某种质，而这种质个别者有好几个。

en: b) Reflection is the going beyond a single determination, its comparison with others, and the combining of them into one determinate. – The universal constitutes the inner nature and the essence of the object.
This universality is not only a commonality, but the object's own universality in itself, in contrast to the determinations of its own particularity or individuality.
zh: b) 反思就是越出一项单独的规定，把它同别的规定相比较，并把这些规定归摄为一个规定。——普遍者构成对象的内在本性和本质。
这一普遍性不只是一种共同性，而是对象在它自身上的特有普遍性，与它自身的特殊性或个别性的诸规定相对立。

en: c) The proper judging of an object is the comparing of its nature or true universality with its individuality or with the quality of its determinate being, the comparing of what it is with what it ought to be.
zh: c) 对一个对象的真正判断，就是把它的本性或真正的普遍性同它的个别性、或同它定在的属性相比较，就是把它所是的同它应当是的相比较。

en: In these judgments there lies the dialectic that the bad, that does not correspond to its concept, is at the same time also adequate to it.
A bad house has a determinate being that is not adequate to its concept.
But if it were not even adequate to it, it would not be a house at all.
The concept must still be recognizable in the determinate being.
So, when an action is judged to be bad, its irrationality still has an aspect of agreement with reason, usf.
zh: 在这些判断里潜藏着这样的辩证法：恶的、与它的概念不相符合的东西同时也是适合它的。
一所坏房子有一种与它的概念不相适合的定在。
但要是它连这一点也不适合，那它就根本不是一所房子。
概念在这定在里还必须是可以辨认出来的。
同样，当人们判定一个行为是恶的时候，它的非理性仍然有一面与理性相符合，usf.

en: Here too acuteness may be mentioned, which, however, has more to do with a quality of judging than with being an actual stage of it.

It consists chiefly in apprehending differences that do not lie on the surface and in noticing through reflection subtler or deeper relations. – Wit connects, according to their external appearance, mutually foreign representations with respect to one aspect in which they present an unexpected equality. – The ingenious is an analogue of the rational and expresses above all a determination or relation in which it is opposed to its immediate representation or to itself.
zh: 这里也可以提一提敏锐，不过它更多涉及判断的一种性质，而不是判断的一个现实阶段。
它主要在于把握那些不浮在表面的差异，并通过反思察觉更精细或更深的关系。——机智按照表象的外在样子，把彼此陌生的表象归到一起，所取的是它们在某一面上呈现出一种意外相等的那一面。——巧妙是理性的类比，主要表达这样一项规定或关系：它与自己的直接表象相对立，或者与它自身相对立。

en: At sunrise the sky was transformed from black into red like a crab. – Le miserable, qu'il est heureux!

Il a faim. – Exul mentisque domusque. – Beneath this stone lies my wife, and here she rests, and I too. – On their beds of ease the fat judges dream, to lull their cough and their conscience to sleep at the same time, usf.
zh: 太阳升起时，天空像一只螃蟹那样由黑变红。——Le miserable, qu'il est heureux!
Il a faim。——Exul mentisque domusque。——这块石头下面躺着我的妻子，她躺在这里，我也躺在这里。——那些肥胖的法官在他们的卧榻上做梦，要把他们的咳嗽和他们的良心同时哄睡着，usf.

en: a) Reason is negative or dialectical, in that it exhibits the passage of a determinacy of the understanding belonging to being into its opposite.
Usually the dialectical appears in such a way that two opposite predicates are predicated of a subject.

The purer dialectical consists in this: that a determinacy of the understanding is exhibited from a predicate, in that it is just as much in itself the opposite of itself, and thus sublates itself in itself.
zh: a) 理性是否定的，或者说辩证的，因为它展示出存在的一项知性规定过渡到与之相反的规定。
通常，辩证的东西是这样出现的：对一个主体断言两个相反的谓词。
更纯粹的辩证的东西在于：从一个谓词出发展示出一项知性的规定，说明它自在本身同样就是自身的对立面，因而它就在自身中扬弃自身。

en: b) Reasoning reason seeks out the grounds of things, i.e. their being determined through and in an other, which is the essence remaining in itself of the same, yet at the same time only a relatively unconditional, since what is grounded, or the consequence, has a different content from the ground.
zh: b) 推论的理性追索事物的根据，也就是事物通过并在一个他物之中而被设定的状态；这个他物就是它们留在自身的本质，但同时又只是一个相对无条件的东西，因为被根据者、也就是结果，其内容与根据不同。

en: c) Syllogistic reason contains the mediation of a content which, according to the determinacies of the concept, relates itself as singular, particular, and universal.

The particular is a universal with respect to the singular and a determinate with respect to the universal; it is the middle which contains within itself the extremes of singularity and universality, and hence concludes them together.
Syllogistic reason is:
zh: c) 推论的理性包含着这样一个内容的中介：这个内容按照概念的规定，表现为个别、特殊和一般。
特殊对个别来说是一般，对一般来说是一个有规定的东西；它就是那个中项，内含着个别性与普遍性这两个极端，因而把它们归结在一起。
推论的理性是：

en: α) formal reason, insofar as the syllogism is subjective.
What appears therein as mediated or as consequence is in itself the immediate.
It has the relation of something mediated only for knowing.
zh: α) 形式的理性，就推论是主观的而言。
其中作为被中介者、作为结果而出现的东西，在自在本身是直接的东西。
它具有被中介者的这种关系，只是就认识而言。

en: β) Teleological reason contemplates and posits purposes, a relation in which the mediated or produced has the same content as the immediate, the presupposed concept, and in which the mediated, the consequence, is just as much the ground.
zh: β) 目的论的理性观照并设定目的，这就是一种关系：其中被中介者、所产生的东西与直接的东西、即预先设定的概念，具有同样的内容；而在其中，被中介者、也就是结果，同样就是根据。

en: γ) The rational idea is the concept, insofar as its externality or its reality is completely determined through it and exists only in its concept, or the existent which has its own concept in it, the means of the concept itself, the means thus being just as much purpose.
zh: γ) 理性的观念就是概念，就其外在性或其实在性通过它而得到完全规定、并且只在它的概念之中存在而言；或者说，存在者——它在这个概念之中具有自己的概念——就是概念自身的手段，所以这个手段同样是目的。

153.zh: 第二部分 实践精神

en: The practical spirit does not merely have ideas, but is the living idea itself.
It is the spirit that determines itself out of itself and gives externality to its determinacies.
A distinction must be made between the I as it makes itself an object, objectivity, only theoretically or ideally, and as it makes itself an object, objectivity, practically or really.
zh: 实践精神不只是具有观念，它本身就是活的观念。
它是那种从自身出发规定自己、并把外在性赋予自身各项规定的精神。
这里要区分自我：自我只在理论上或以观念的方式使自己成为对象、成为客观性，与自我在实践上或以实在的方式使自己成为对象、成为客观性。

en: The practical spirit is called above all free will, insofar as the I can abstract from all determinacy in which it is and remain indeterminate within all determinacy and in equality with itself.
zh: 实践精神主要被称为自由意志，就自我能够撇开它所处的一切规定性，并在一切规定性中保持不确定、保持与自身的同一而言。

en: The will as the concept determining inwardly is essentially activity and action.
It translates its inner determinacies into external determinate being, in order to represent itself as idea.
zh: 意志作为在内部起规定作用的概念，本质上是活动和行为。
它把自己的内部规定转化为外在的定在，以便把自己表现为观念。

en: To the deed belongs the entire range of determinations which stand in immediate connection with an alteration of determinate being that has been brought about.
To the action belongs to begin with only that which of it was present in the resolve or in consciousness.
Only this does the will acknowledge as its own and as its guilt, which can properly be imputed to it.
But in the broader sense this too is to be taken up under the guilt: what of the determinations of the deed was not conscious, but could have become conscious.
zh: 属于行为的，是全部那些与所造成的定在的改变直接相联系的规定。
属于行动的，起初只是其中在决心或意识中已有的东西。
只有这一部分，意志才认作自己的东西、认作自己的罪过，因为只有它才能真正归责于意志。
不过在更宽的意义上，行为的那些规定中未被意识到、但本可以意识到的东西，同样也要归入罪过。

en: a) The practical feeling does indeed comprehend within itself the practical legal and moral determinations and laws, but it comprehends them immediately, hence undeveloped and unthought, and above all impure through the admixture of subjective individuality.

It is essential to observe that the practical feeling has no other true content than the rights, duties and laws that are known in a determinate manner, – that it is on the one hand obscure and determined by individuality, on the other hand it can be raised above the determinate consciousness of those same rights, duties and laws only insofar as it holds fast to them one by one and can be a totality against them.
zh: a) 实践的感觉确实把实践的法权规定、道德规定和规律以概念把握在自己之内，但把握得很直接，因此是未展开的、未被思考的，而且主要由于掺入了主观的个别性而不纯净。
必须从本质上注意：实践的感觉除了那些被明确知道的权利、义务和规律以外没有别的真实内容，——一方面它是晦暗的、由个别性所规定的，另一方面只有当它一个一个地坚持这些权利、义务和规律、并且能够针对它们成为一个总体性时，它才能被提升到对它们的明确意识之上。

en: b) The feeling of a practical determination together with the feeling of its contradiction – of being an inward, unrealized something, yet in which reality is at the same time essential – is the drive.
It belongs to subjective nature and is directed only towards its determinacy.
Desire is a single determination of the drive, and through the suitability or unsuitability of external being to it the feeling becomes the agreeable or the disagreeable.
In drive and desire the practical spirit is within naturalness a dependent, unfree being.
zh: b) 对一项实践规定的感觉，连同对它的矛盾的感觉——即感到自己是一个内部的、未实现的东西，而同时实在性对它又本质地属于它——就是冲动。
它属于主观的自然，只朝向自己的规定性。
欲望是冲动的一个个别规定，而由于外在的定在与它相适合或不相适合，感觉就变成愉快或不愉快。
在冲动和欲望中，实践精神在自然性里是一个依赖的、不自由的存在。

en: c) The spirit must raise itself out of its immersion in the drives to universality, so that the drives do not count as absolute for themselves in their particularity, but their determinations receive their place and their proper value only as moments of the totality, by which they are purified of subjective contingency.
zh: c) 精神必须从沉陷于冲动之中上升到普遍性，使这些冲动不在其特殊性上自在地把自己当作绝对的，而是让它们的规定只有作为总体性的环节才得到自己的位置和正确的价值，由此它们从主观的偶然性中净化出来。

en: The determinations of the spirit make up its laws.

They are however not external or natural determinations of it; its single determination, in which all of them are contained, is its freedom, which is both the form and the content of its law, and this law can be a legal, a moral or a political one.
zh: 精神的诸规定构成它的规律。
但这些规定并不是精神的外在的或自然的诸规定；精神唯一的规定——它们全都包含在其中——就是自由，而自由既是它的规律的形式，也是它的规律的内容，这个规律可以是法权的、道德的或政治的。

en: The spirit as a free, self-conscious being is the self-identical I which, in its absolutely negative relation, is first an excluding I, an individual free being or person.
zh: 精神作为自由的、自我意识的存在，是那个与自身相同的自我；它在绝对否定性的关系中首先是排他性的自我、单个的自由存在或人格。

en: Right is the relation of human beings insofar as they are abstract persons.
That action is wrongful through which a human being is not respected as a person, or which makes an inroad into the sphere of his freedom.
This relation is therefore negative in nature according to its basic determination, and it does not demand that anything positive be shown to the other as such, but only that he be left as a person.
zh: 权利是人之间的关系，只要他们是抽象的人格。
那种使人未被当作人格来尊重、或者侵入他的自由领域的行动，就是不正义的。
所以这一关系就其基本规定而言是否定性的，它并不要求向他人真正出示某种正面的东西，而只要求让他作为人格存在下去。

en: The external sphere of right and freedom constitutes property, the subsumption of an ownerless thing under my power and my will.
Possession is the side of arbitrary seizure.
The side of property as such is the universal side, that possession is an expression of my will which, as something absolute, must be respected by the other.
zh: 法权与自由的外在领域构成财产，即把一件无主之物归摄到我的强力与我的意志之下。
占有是任意攫取的那一面。
财产作为财产的那一面就是普遍的一面：占有是我的意志的一种表示，而这种意志作为绝对的东西，必须为他人所尊重。
